title: Feature Request: SMS bolus blocked for 15 minutes after there was a local bolus on the main device
body:
Currently there is already a similar security feature blocking next SMS bolus more often than every 15 minutes.
It would be also useful to have a similar security feature extended for any local bolus - also non-SMS in the last 15 minutes.
Example:
- as Parent I can see my child's BS going high and would like to correct it using SMS Bolus. I will however not do it as I am not sure if my child do not see it at the same time and does a correction almost at the same time as well
- If the SMS bolus would be blocked 15 minutes after any bolus has happened on AAPS device then I could still send the command and eventually get it refused

comments.body:
Isn't 15 minutes too much? You need to send 2 SMS messages anyway. How about that:
1. Caregiver phone: send SMS command
2. Patient phone: send reply asking for verification code and information about boluses during last X minutes (5?). Disable all boluses for the next Y (5?) minutes.
3. Caregiver phone: send SMS with verification PIN if you wish to proceed
No, my understanding of the feature was wrong as I have created the issue. I thought that the Patient phone bolus is not blocking the SMS bolus at all. 15 minutes are absolutely OK!
